description: This file defines interfaces for managing TextTrack features such as Closed Captions styles, TTML styles, capabilities, and session handling within the WPEFramework. It includes class and method declarations for setting styles, handling sessions, and querying capabilities related to text tracks.

classes.name: ITextTrackClosedCaptionsStyle
classes.description: Interface for managing Closed Captions styles, including setting styles, registering notifications, and handling style change events.

classes.name: ITextTrackTtmlStyle
classes.description: Interface for managing global TTML style overrides, including setting and retrieving style strings.

classes.name: ITextTrackCapabilities
classes.description: Interface for querying TextTrack capabilities, such as support for specific features.

classes.name: ITextTrack
classes.description: Interface for handling TextTrack sessions, data injection, style application, and mode configuration.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for style changes.

methods.name: SetClosedCaptionsStyle
methods.description: Sets the style for Closed Captions.

methods.name: GetClosedCaptionsStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the current Closed Captions style.

methods.name: SetFontFamily
methods.description: Sets the font family for captions.

methods.name: GetFontFamily
methods.description: Gets the current font family setting.

methods.name: SetFontSize
methods.description: Sets the font size for captions.

methods.name: GetFontSize
methods.description: Gets the current font size setting.

methods.name: GetCapability
methods.description: Queries support for a specific TextTrack capability.

methods.name: GetCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supported TextTrack capabilities.

methods.name: ResetSession
methods.description: Resets a TextTrack session to its initial state.

methods.name: SendSessionData
methods.description: Sends caption or text data to a session.

methods.name: SendSessionTimestamp
methods.description: Sends a timestamp to a session.

methods.name: ApplyCustomClosedCaptionsStyleToSession
methods.description: Applies a custom style to a specific session.

methods.name: SetPreviewText
methods.description: Sets static preview text in a session.

methods.name: SetSessionClosedCaptionsService
methods.description: Configures CC mode for a session.

methods.name: SetSessionTeletextSelection
methods.description: Configures Teletext mode for a session.

methods.name: SetSessionDvbSubtitleSelection
methods.description: Configures DVB Subtitle mode for a session.

methods.name: SetSessionWebVTTSelection
methods.description: Configures WebVTT mode for a session.

methods.name: SetSessionTTMLSelection
methods.description: Configures TTML mode for a session.

methods.name: SetSessionSCTESelection
methods.description: Configures SCTE mode for a session.

methods.name: ApplyCustomTtmlStyleOverridesToSession
methods.description: Overrides TTML styles for a session.

methods.name: AssociateVideoDecoder
methods.description: Associates a video decoder with a session for caption data.

methods.name: GetInterfaceVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the interface implemented.
